name: Sitios Latinoamérica, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: Sitios Latinoamérica, S.A.B. de C.V., through its subsidiaries, provides wireless telecommunications infrastructure services and solutions in Latin America. The company builds, installs, maintains, operates, and markets towers, support structures, physical spaces, and other non-electronic elements of passive infrastructure for the installation of radiocommunications equipment and other active infrastructure; provides related services to the telecommunication sector; and leases tower spaces. It serves radio communication service providers, primarily concessionaires of public wireless telecommunications networks.
